# VoiceReason.AI

> VoiceReason.AI is practice phone calls with an AI voice that sounds like a real person. It has two products. Sales Coach: sales and service teams practice a real conversation with an AI buyer. Interview Coach: a job seeker adds their resume and a job posting, and an AI hiring manager runs a structured, behavioral practice interview for that role. In both, the caller dials one phone number and says an access code. On Sales Coach Practice + Coach, an AI coach comes on the same phone call right after the practice call ends; new plans with the AI coach on every plan are coming soon. After every call, a written feedback report with the full transcript is emailed once the person has an email on file. Interview Coach and the free trial are coming soon.

VoiceReason.AI is made by Pyrigen Incorporated.

## How it works

- No app, no download and no login for the team member. They dial a number and give their access code.
- The buyer is software with a synthetic voice, not a person. So is the coach.
- Practice calls are recorded, and the line says so.
- The written report covers discovery, qualification, how objections were handled, and whether the call ended with a real next step.
- Practice conversations belong to the customer's account. VoiceReason.AI does not use calls to train AI for anyone else, and turns off model training with its providers wherever they allow it.
- There is nothing to integrate and no CRM to connect. The manager issues codes and sends them out.

## Plans (per seat)

- For sale today (Sales Coach): Practice, $69 per seat per month or $759 per seat per year, 280 minutes a seat each month, with a written feedback report and full transcript after every call. Practice + Coach, $129 per seat per month, 420 minutes a seat each month, with a live AI coach on the same call right after every practice call.
- Coming soon: Starter (90 minutes a seat each month), Standard (240) and Pro (480), each with the live AI coach on every plan, for Sales Coach and Interview Coach. Pricing coming soon. Coaching time uses the same minutes.
- All the seats on a plan share one pool of minutes. Month to month.
- One seat is one person who makes practice calls, with one access code. The manager login does not use a seat.
- Customers can cancel at any time. Canceling stops the next charge, and the plan stays active through the period already paid for.
